info.short_name: ADD: ADHD Medication Follow-up (Child, Continuation)
info.long_name: Follow-up Care for Children Prescribed ADHD Medication – Continuation and Maintenance Phase
info.short_description: Percent of children on ADHD medication with follow-up visits during the continuation and maintenance phase.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (ADD). Continuation and maintenance phase: percentage of children who remained on ADHD medication for at least 210 days and had at least two follow-up visits within the 9-month continuation period. Associated columns: medicaid_add_ch_cont_rate, medicaid_add_ch_cont_pct_25, medicaid_add_ch_cont_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children on ADHD medication had appropriate follow-up during the continuation phase

info.short_name: ADD: ADHD Medication Follow-up (Child, Initiation)
info.long_name: Follow-up Care for Children Prescribed ADHD Medication – Initiation Phase
info.short_description: Percent of children newly prescribed ADHD medication who had at least one follow-up visit during the initiation phase.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (ADD). Initiation phase: percentage of children aged 6–12 newly prescribed ADHD medication who had at least one follow-up visit with a prescriber within 30 days. Associated columns: medicaid_add_ch_init_rate, medicaid_add_ch_init_pct_25, medicaid_add_ch_init_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children newly prescribed ADHD medication had a follow-up visit during the initiation phase

info.short_name: FUH: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness (Child, 30-Day)
info.long_name: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness – Children, Within 30 Days
info.short_description: Percent of children with a follow-up visit within 30 days after hospitalization for mental illness.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (FUH). Percentage of children aged 6–17 discharged from an acute inpatient setting for mental illness who had a follow-up visit within 30 days. Associated columns: medicaid_fuh_ch_30d_rate, medicaid_fuh_ch_30d_pct_25, medicaid_fuh_ch_30d_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children had follow-up within 30 days after hospitalization for mental illness

info.short_name: FUH: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness (Child, 7-Day)
info.long_name: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness – Children, Within 7 Days
info.short_description: Percent of children with a follow-up visit within 7 days after hospitalization for mental illness.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (FUH). Percentage of children aged 6–17 discharged from an acute inpatient setting for mental illness who had a follow-up visit within 7 days. Associated columns: medicaid_fuh_ch_7d_rate, medicaid_fuh_ch_7d_pct_25, medicaid_fuh_ch_7d_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children had follow-up within 7 days after hospitalization for mental illness

info.short_name: AMB: Ambulatory Care – ED Visits (Child)
info.long_name: Ambulatory Care – Emergency Department Utilization, Children
info.short_description: Rate of emergency department visits among children per 1,000 member months.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (AMB). Rate of ED visits per 1,000 Medicaid/CHIP member months for children. Lower rates may indicate better access to primary care. Associated columns: medicaid_amb_ch_rate, medicaid_amb_ch_pct_25, medicaid_amb_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, children had {value} ED visits per 1,000 member months

info.short_name: MMA: Medication Management for Asthma (Child)
info.long_name: Medication Management for People with Asthma – Children
info.short_description: Percent of children with asthma who were on long-term control medication for at least 75% of their treatment period.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (MMA). Percentage of children aged 5–18 with persistent asthma who were dispensed appropriate medications for at least 75% of their treatment period. Associated columns: medicaid_mma_ch_rate, medicaid_mma_ch_pct_25, medicaid_mma_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children with asthma received appropriate long-term control medication

info.short_name: FPC: First Prenatal Care Visit (Child)
info.long_name: First Prenatal Care Visit – Adolescents
info.short_description: Percent of adolescent females who received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (FPC). Percentage of adolescent females aged 15–20 who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester. Associated columns: medicaid_fpc_ch_rate, medicaid_fpc_ch_pct_25, medicaid_fpc_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent mothers received first-trimester prenatal care

info.short_name: LBW: Low Birthweight (Child)
info.long_name: Live Births Weighing Less Than 2,500 Grams – Children
info.short_description: Percent of live births weighing less than 2,500 grams among Medicaid/CHIP deliveries.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (LBW). Percentage of live singleton deliveries that resulted in a low birthweight infant (less than 2,500 grams). Lower rates indicate better outcomes. Associated columns: medicaid_lbw_ch_rate, medicaid_lbw_ch_pct_25, medicaid_lbw_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of Medicaid/CHIP births resulted in low birthweight

info.short_name: PPC: Prenatal and Postpartum Care (Child)
info.long_name: Prenatal and Postpartum Care – Adolescents
info.short_description: Percent of adolescent females who received timely prenatal and postpartum care.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (PPC). Percentage of adolescent females aged 15–20 who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester and a postpartum visit within 21–56 days of delivery. Associated columns: medicaid_ppc_ch_rate, medicaid_ppc_ch_pct_25, medicaid_ppc_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent mothers received timely prenatal and postpartum care

info.short_name: AWC: Adolescent Well-Care Visits
info.long_name: Adolescent Well-Care Visits
info.short_description: Percent of adolescents who had at least one comprehensive well-care visit.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (AWC). Percentage of adolescents aged 12–21 who had at least one comprehensive well-care visit with a PCP or OB/GYN practitioner during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_awc_ch_rate, medicaid_awc_ch_pct_25, medicaid_awc_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents had a comprehensive well-care visit

info.short_name: CAP: Children's Access to Primary Care
info.long_name: Children and Adolescents' Access to Primary Care Practitioners
info.short_description: Percent of children who had a visit with a PCP during the measurement year.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (CAP). Percentage of children aged 12 months–19 years who had at least one visit with a primary care practitioner during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_cap_ch_rate, medicaid_cap_ch_pct_25, medicaid_cap_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children had access to a primary care practitioner

info.short_name: CHL: Chlamydia Screening in Women (Child/Adolescent)
info.long_name: Chlamydia Screening in Women – Adolescents
info.short_description: Percent of sexually active adolescent females screened for chlamydia.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (CHL). Percentage of sexually active adolescent females aged 16–20 who were screened for chlamydia during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_chl_ch_rate, medicaid_chl_ch_pct_25, medicaid_chl_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescent females were screened for chlamydia

info.short_name: CIS: Childhood Immunization Status (Alternate, Child)
info.long_name: Childhood Immunization Status (CIS)
info.short_description: Percent of children who received all recommended vaccinations by age 2.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (CIS). Alternate childhood immunization status measure. Tracks the combination of recommended vaccines received by children by their second birthday. Associated columns: medicaid_cis_ch_rate, medicaid_cis_ch_pct_25, medicaid_cis_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children completed the childhood immunization series

info.short_name: HPV: HPV Vaccine for Adolescents (FFY 2014–2016)
info.long_name: Human Papillomavirus Vaccine for Female Adolescents
info.short_description: Percent of female adolescents who received three HPV vaccine doses by their 13th birthday.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (HPV), reported FFY 2014–2016 only. Percentage of female adolescents who turned 13 during the measurement year and received three doses of HPV vaccine by their 13th birthday. Associated columns: medicaid_hpv_ch_rate, medicaid_hpv_ch_pct_25, medicaid_hpv_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents received the HPV vaccine series

info.short_name: IMA: Immunizations for Adolescents (MenACWY and Tdap)
info.long_name: Immunizations for Adolescents, Combination 1
info.short_description: Percent of adolescents who received one meningococcal (MenACWY) and one Tdap dose by their 13th birthday.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (IMA), Combination 1. Percentage of adolescents who turned 13 during the measurement year and had one dose of meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) and one Tdap dose by their 13th birthday. Associated columns: medicaid_ima_ch_rate, medicaid_ima_ch_pct_25, medicaid_ima_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents received MenACWY and Tdap by age 13

info.short_name: W15: Well-Child Visits in the First 15 Months
info.long_name: Well-Child Visits in the First 15 Months of Life
info.short_description: Percent of children who had the recommended number of well-child visits in the first 15 months of life.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (W15). Percentage of children who turned 15 months old and had six or more well-child visits with a PCP during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_w15_ch_rate, medicaid_w15_ch_pct_25, medicaid_w15_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children had recommended well-child visits in the first 15 months

info.short_name: W34: Well-Child Visits Ages 3–4
info.long_name: Well-Child Visits for Children Ages 3 to 4
info.short_description: Percent of children ages 3–4 who had at least one well-child visit.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (W34). Percentage of children aged 3–4 who had at least one well-child visit with a PCP during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_w34_ch_rate, medicaid_w34_ch_pct_25, medicaid_w34_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children ages 3–4 had a well-child visit

info.short_name: WCC: Weight Assessment and Counseling for Children
info.long_name: Weight Assessment and Counseling for Nutrition and Physical Activity for Children/Adolescents
info.short_description: Percent of children with a BMI percentile, physical activity counseling, and nutrition counseling documented.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (WCC). Percentage of children aged 3–17 who had an outpatient visit with a BMI percentile documented and received counseling for nutrition and physical activity. Associated columns: medicaid_wcc_ch_rate, medicaid_wcc_ch_pct_25, medicaid_wcc_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children received weight assessment and nutrition/physical activity counseling

info.short_name: AMM: Antidepressant Medication Management (Adult)
info.long_name: Antidepressant Medication Management – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of adults with a new diagnosis of depression who remained on antidepressant medication.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (AMM). Percentage of adults aged 18 and older diagnosed with a new episode of major depression who remained on antidepressant medication during the acute treatment phase. Associated columns: medicaid_amm_ad_rate, medicaid_amm_ad_pct_25, medicaid_amm_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults with new depression remained on antidepressant medication

info.long_name: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness – Adults, Within 30 Days

info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (FUH). Percentage of adults aged 18 and older discharged from an acute inpatient setting for mental illness who had a follow-up visit within 30 days. Associated columns: medicaid_fuh_ad_30d_rate, medicaid_fuh_ad_30d_pct_25, medicaid_fuh_ad_30d_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults had follow-up within 30 days after hospitalization for mental illness

info.long_name: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness – Adults, Within 7 Days

info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults had follow-up within 7 days after hospitalization for mental illness

info.short_name: HA1C: Comprehensive Diabetes Care – HbA1c Testing (Adult, Alternate)
info.long_name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care – Hemoglobin A1c Testing (HA1C)
info.short_description: Percent of adults with diabetes who received an HbA1c test (alternate measure).
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (HA1C). Alternate comprehensive diabetes care measure tracking HbA1c testing among adults with diabetes. Associated columns: medicaid_ha1c_ad_rate, medicaid_ha1c_ad_pct_25, medicaid_ha1c_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults with diabetes received an HbA1c test

info.short_name: LDL: Comprehensive Diabetes Care – LDL-C Screening (Adult)
info.long_name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care – LDL-C Screening, Adults
info.short_description: Percent of adults with diabetes who received an LDL-C screening.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (LDL). Percentage of adults aged 18–75 with diabetes who had an LDL-C test during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_ldl_ad_rate, medicaid_ldl_ad_pct_25, medicaid_ldl_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults with diabetes received an LDL-C screening

info.short_name: PDENT: Preventive Dental Services (Child)
info.long_name: Preventive Dental Services – Children
info.short_description: Percent of children who received at least one preventive dental service.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (PDENT). Percentage of children aged 1–20 who received at least one preventive dental service (e.g., cleaning, fluoride, sealants) during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_pdent_ch_rate, medicaid_pdent_ch_pct_25, medicaid_pdent_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children received preventive dental services

info.short_name: TDENT: Total Dental Services (Child)
info.long_name: Total Dental Services – Children
info.short_description: Percent of children who received any dental service during the measurement year.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (TDENT). Percentage of children aged 1–20 enrolled in Medicaid/CHIP who received any dental service during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_tdent_ch_rate, medicaid_tdent_ch_pct_25, medicaid_tdent_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children received any dental service

info.short_name: PPC: Prenatal and Postpartum Care (Adult)
info.long_name: Prenatal and Postpartum Care – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of adult women who received timely prenatal and postpartum care.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (PPC). Percentage of women aged 21–44 who had a live birth and received a prenatal care visit in the first trimester and a postpartum visit within 21–56 days of delivery. Associated columns: medicaid_ppc_ad_rate, medicaid_ppc_ad_pct_25, medicaid_ppc_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adult women received timely prenatal and postpartum care

info.short_name: ABA: Adult BMI Assessment
info.long_name: Adult Body Mass Index Assessment
info.short_description: Percent of adults who had their BMI documented during an outpatient visit.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (ABA). Percentage of adults aged 18–74 who had their BMI documented during an outpatient visit. Associated columns: medicaid_aba_ad_rate, medicaid_aba_ad_pct_25, medicaid_aba_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults had their BMI documented during an outpatient visit

info.short_name: BCS: Breast Cancer Screening (Adult)
info.long_name: Breast Cancer Screening – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of women aged 50–74 who received a mammogram for breast cancer screening.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (BCS). Percentage of women aged 50–74 who had at least one mammogram during the measurement year or the year prior. Associated columns: medicaid_bcs_ad_rate, medicaid_bcs_ad_pct_25, medicaid_bcs_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of women received breast cancer screening

info.short_name: CCS: Cervical Cancer Screening (Adult)
info.long_name: Cervical Cancer Screening – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of women aged 21–64 who received appropriate cervical cancer screening.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (CCS). Percentage of women aged 21–64 who had appropriate cervical cancer screening (Pap smear within 3 years or Pap + HPV co-test within 5 years). Associated columns: medicaid_ccs_ad_rate, medicaid_ccs_ad_pct_25, medicaid_ccs_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of women received cervical cancer screening

info.short_name: CHL: Chlamydia Screening in Women (Adult)
info.long_name: Chlamydia Screening in Women – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of sexually active adult women screened for chlamydia.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (CHL). Percentage of sexually active women aged 21–24 who were screened for chlamydia during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_chl_ad_rate, medicaid_chl_ad_pct_25, medicaid_chl_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adult women were screened for chlamydia

info.short_name: SEAL: Sealant Receipt (Child)
info.long_name: Sealant Receipt on Permanent Teeth – Children
info.short_description: Percent of children who received sealants on permanent teeth.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (SEAL). Percentage of children who received a dental sealant on at least one permanent tooth during the measurement year. Associated columns: medicaid_seal_ch_rate, medicaid_seal_ch_pct_25, medicaid_seal_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children received a sealant on a permanent tooth

info.short_name: MSC: Medical Assistance with Smoking/Tobacco Cessation (Adult)
info.long_name: Medical Assistance with Smoking and Tobacco Use Cessation – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of adults who were screened for tobacco use and received cessation counseling or medication.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (MSC). Percentage of adults aged 18 and older who were current smokers or tobacco users and received advice to quit and/or medication to assist cessation. Associated columns: medicaid_msc_ad_rate, medicaid_msc_ad_pct_25, medicaid_msc_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults received tobacco cessation assistance

info.short_name: SAA: Adherence to Antipsychotics for Schizophrenia (Adult)
info.long_name: Adherence to Antipsychotic Medications for Individuals with Schizophrenia – Adults
info.short_description: Percent of adults with schizophrenia who remained on antipsychotic medication for at least 80% of their treatment period.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (SAA). Percentage of individuals aged 18–64 with schizophrenia who were dispensed and remained on an antipsychotic medication for at least 80% of their treatment period. Associated columns: medicaid_saa_ad_rate, medicaid_saa_ad_pct_25, medicaid_saa_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults with schizophrenia adhered to antipsychotic medications

info.short_name: ADD: ADHD Medication Follow-up (Child, 30-Day)
info.long_name: Follow-up Care for Children Prescribed ADHD Medication – 30-Day Follow-up
info.short_description: Percent of children prescribed ADHD medication with a follow-up visit within 30 days.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (ADD). 30-day follow-up phase component. Associated columns: medicaid_add_ch_30d_rate, medicaid_add_ch_30d_pct_25, medicaid_add_ch_30d_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children prescribed ADHD medication had a follow-up visit within 30 days

info.short_name: APC: Use of Opioids at High Dosage (Child)
info.long_name: Use of Opioids at High Dosage in Persons Without Cancer – Children
info.short_description: Percent of children receiving high-dosage opioid prescriptions without a cancer diagnosis.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (APC). Percentage of children and adolescents without cancer who received prescriptions for opioids with a high average daily dosage. info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children without cancer received high-dosage opioids

info.short_name: DEV: Developmental Screening in the First Three Years
info.long_name: Developmental Screening in the First Three Years of Life
info.short_description: Percent of children who were screened for developmental delays by age 3.
info.long_description: Child Core Set measure (DEV). Percentage of children who turned 1, 2, or 3 years old and had at least one standardized developmental screening using a validated screening instrument. Associated columns: medicaid_dev_ch_rate, medicaid_dev_ch_pct_25, medicaid_dev_ch_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of young children were screened for developmental delays

info.short_name: SSD: Diabetes Screening for People with Schizophrenia/Bipolar on Antipsychotics (Adult)
info.long_name: Diabetes Screening for People with Schizophrenia or Bipolar Disorder Using Antipsychotic Medications
info.short_description: Percent of adults with schizophrenia or bipolar disorder on antipsychotics who had a diabetes screening.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (SSD). info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults on antipsychotics were screened for diabetes

info.short_description: Rate of hospital admissions for congestive heart failure per 100,000 Medicaid beneficiaries.
info.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (PQI08). Rate of hospital admissions for congestive heart failure per 100,000 beneficiaries. Lower rates suggest better outpatient management. Associated columns: medicaid_pqi08_ad_rate, medicaid_pqi08_ad_pct_25, medicaid_pqi08_ad_pct_75.
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} hospital admissions per 100,000 for congestive heart failure

info.long_name: Immunizations for Adolescents, HPV Vaccine Series

info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents completed the HPV vaccine series by age 13

info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} hospital admissions per 100,000 for COPD

info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} hospital admissions per 100,000 for adult asthma

info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of children newly prescribed antipsychotics received first-line psychosocial care

medicaid_nciidd_ad_rate.long_description: Adult Core Set measure (NCIIDD), new for FFY 2024, drawn from the National Core Indicators (NCI) survey of adults receiving long-term services and supports, primarily those with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Percentage of surveyed adults who reported making choices about their own life decisions, including residence, work, day activity, staff, and roommates. NCIIDD also reports components on daily-schedule/spending choice and on reliable transportation under this same abbreviation; because CMS does not expose them as separate fields, this column retains only the life-decisions component. Associated columns: medicaid_nciidd_ad_rate, medicaid_nciidd_ad_pct_25, medicaid_nciidd_ad_pct_75.

medicaid_quality_cms.name: Medicaid and CHIP Adult and Child Core Set Quality Measures
medicaid_quality_cms.location: Medicaid.gov Open Data – Quality Measures datasets (2014–2025)
medicaid_quality_cms.description: Annual state-level performance data on the Medicaid and CHIP Adult Core Set and Child Core Set quality measures, as voluntarily reported by states to CMS and analyzed by Mathematica via the Quality Measure Reporting (QMR) system. Measures span behavioral health (e.g., follow-up after ED visits for mental illness, substance use disorder treatment), primary and preventive care (e.g., well-child visits, immunizations), maternal and perinatal health (e.g., prenatal and postpartum care, low birthweight), dental health, care of chronic conditions (e.g., diabetes, asthma, hypertension), and long-term services and supports. Each annual dataset includes state rates and national 25th and 75th percentile benchmarks. Data cover federal fiscal years 2014–2025. Reporting is voluntary; not all states report all measures each year, and some measures newly introduced in FFY 2024/2025 have no state-level values yet. When a single measure abbreviation covers multiple distinct rate definitions that CMS does not expose as separate fields (e.g., different age bands, vaccine types, or survey questions), the standard file keeps one representative sub-component per column rather than averaging or summing across them; affected measures are noted in their individual descriptions. The wide-format standard file contains one row per state-year-payer-domain combination, with each measure-statistic combination as a separate column following the naming convention medicaid_{measure_abbr}_{population}_{sub_metric}_{stat} where population is 'ch' (child) or 'ad' (adult), sub_metric captures time windows or sub-components, and stat is 'rate', 'pct_25', or 'pct_75'.
